Priya Rao: FYI final onsite for Jordan Patel (PM candidate) Wed Jul 8. Candidate has reduced mobility; needs ground-floor room or guaranteed elevator access and an accessible restroom. Also asked about travel reimbursement timeline. Can Facilities & Evelyn confirm?

Noah Rivera: I can interview 10:00-12:30 PDT. I can do product + PM case. Will need whiteboard and projector in room.

Evelyn Park: Noted. I'll block a ground-floor room (SF-Grove-1) and request an accessible table. Ordering lunches: gluten-free and dairy-free options noted. Filing loaner laptop request if needed.

Facilities: SF-Grove-1 reserved and ramp/elevator route confirmed. We'll place an accessibility sign and a reserved seat near entrance. Front desk will be notified to escort. Parking: reserved accessible spot near main entrance under candidate name.

Priya Rao: Reimbursement policy: we reimburse flights and up to 2 nights hotel plus ground transport within policy. For faster turnaround we can advance hotel on company card if candidate sends receipts and signed advance form. Finance lead approved ENG-HIRE-TRAVEL code. Evelyn please handle vendor payment if requested.

Evelyn Park: Will prepare travel advance packet and PO if needed. Candidate asked about per diem; standard $75/day available. Also scheduling note: add 20-min buffer before loop for candidate check-in and tech setup.

People Ops Bot: Calendar hold set 2026-07-08 09:30-13:00 PDT with 20-min setup buffer. Zoom fallback included. RSVP statuses: Noah (accepted), Hiring Manager (pending), Panelists (pending). Secure email scheduled for 2026-07-07 10:00 PDT with arrival PIN and accessibility instructions.

Priya Rao: Please do not include door codes in calendar. Evelyn, send secure arrival PIN and map of accessible route. Also remind panel to submit feedback within 24h and provide any testing accommodations if required.

Evelyn Park: Done. Loaner Mac booked (ticket #DO-5120) and will be at front desk 09:00-09:30 on the day. Final logistics email will include parking photo instructions for reimbursement and hotel invoice guidance. Closing unless any changes. :white_check_mark:
